promise: Meta announced Quest 3 availability for October 10, 2023, starting at US$499.99 for 128GB.
description: Meta's September 27 announcement specified an October 10, 2023 release, starting at US$499.99 for 128GB. Subsequent reporting confirms the headset launched on that date.
evidence: Meta's Connect announcement establishes the October 10 target and the base-model price.
Android Central's retrospective availability account confirms the October 10, 2023 launch. This rates product availability, not delivery of every individual pre-order.

promise: We believe this will reduce average game time by roughly 25 minutes (pitch clock, as reported).
description: MLB adopted the pitch clock and other pace-of-play rules for the 2023 season, with Manfred promising dramatically shorter games. Average nine-inning game time fell from 3:04 in 2022 to 2:40 in 2023 — a 24-minute reduction.
evidence: Pitch clock implemented from opening day 2023
Average game time dropped 24 minutes from 3:04 (2022) to 2:40 (2023)

review.note: MLB supports reduction in game time during 2023, but retrieved September report is not full-season final result. Exact Manfred quote, September 13 announcement and promised 25-minute metric are unestablished.
